name: Collateral Substitution Confirmation 1 Code
definition: Provides the status of the collateral substitution, either returned or released.

CREL.name: Collateral Substitution Released
CREL.definition: Notification that the collateral substitution, that is new piece(s) of collateral, have been released.

CRET.name: Collateral Substitution Returned
CRET.definition: Confirmation that the collateral substitution, that is new piece(s) of collateral, have been received.
